key_insight: Modeling visual state transitions between clips enables retrieval that preserves object/actor identity and temporal consistency, not just local semantic match. CAST frames retrieval as a consistency-aware problem and operationalizes it for long-form, multi-clip storylines.
problem_solved: Existing video retrieval methods match clips based on local semantic similarity and ignore state/identity continuity, causing incoherent multi-clip results; this work formalizes Consistent Video Retrieval (CVR) and provides tools to benchmark and improve consistency.
method: Formalize the Consistent Video Retrieval (CVR) task and build a diagnostic benchmark spanning YouCook2, COIN, and CrossTask to evaluate state and identity consistency across retrieved clip sequences.
Introduce CAST, a model that explicitly represents visual state transitions between clips so retrieval decisions account for how objects/actors evolve over time rather than only per-clip semantics.
Train with transition-aware objectives and consistency constraints that encourage retrieved sequences to maintain identity and plausible state progressions.
impact: By shifting retrieval from context-agnostic matching to transition-aware selection, CAST enables more coherent multi-clip storylines—useful for video editing, summarization, and downstream multimodal reasoning in long-form video applications.
visual_elements: Timeline diagram comparing context-agnostic retrieval vs. CAST: show how CAST preserves actor/state continuity across retrieved clips.
Architecture sketch of CAST highlighting modules for per-clip encoding, state transition modeling, and consistency-aware scoring.
Benchmark overview: table or Venn diagram of YouCook2, COIN, CrossTask splits and key diagnostic metrics for CVR.
Before/after retrieval examples: side-by-side retrieved clip sequences illustrating improvements in identity/state coherence.
paper_title: CAST: Modeling Visual State Transitions for Consistent Video Retrieval
paper_authors: Yanqing Liu, Yingcheng Liu, Fanghong Dong, Budianto Budianto, Cihang Xie
